mapper.sql: select id, code, code_url, product_type, certificate_id, bind_status, bound_at, created_at, create_by from verification
mapper.select:
where (bind_status is null or bind_status = 0) and certificate_id is null
AND (product_type = 'yangmei' OR product_type IS NULL OR product_type = '')
AND product_type = #{productType}
order by id desc

select MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(code, CHAR_LENGTH(#{monthKey}) + 1) AS UNSIGNED)) from verification where code like concat(#{monthKey}, '%') and SUBSTRING(code, CHAR_LENGTH(#{monthKey}) + 1) regexp '^[0-9]+$'
mapper.insert:
insert into verification (code, code_url, product_type, certificate_id, bind_status, created_at, create_by) values
(#{item.code}, #{item.codeUrl}, #{item.productType}, null, 0, #{item.createdAt}, #{item.createBy})
mapper.delete: delete from verification where id in #{id}
mapper.select: select count(1) from verification where code >= #{startCode} and code <= #{endCode} and char_length(code) = char_length(#{startCode}) and (bind_status = 1 or certificate_id is not null)
mapper.update: update verification set certificate_id = #{certificateId}, bind_status = 1, bound_at = #{boundAt} where code >= #{startCode} and code <= #{endCode} and char_length(code) = char_length(#{startCode}) and (bind_status is null or bind_status = 0) and certificate_id is null
update verification set certificate_id = #{certificateId}, bind_status = 1, bound_at = #{boundAt} where id in #{id} and (bind_status is null or bind_status = 0) and certificate_id is null
mapper.select: select count(1) from verification where id in #{id} and (bind_status = 1 or certificate_id is not null)
select count(1) from verification where certificate_id = #{certificateId}
mapper.update: update verification set certificate_id = null, bind_status = 0, bound_at = null where certificate_id in #{id}
